name: Su Kuo
bio: Su Kuo (蘇過; Su Guo; 1072–1123) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty. He was the youngest son of Su Shih.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 点绛唇 (Dian jiang chun)
poems.author: Su Kuo
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
新月娟娟，夜寒江静山衔斗。
起来搔首。
梅影横窗瘦。
好个霜天，闲却传杯手。
君知否。
乱鸦啼後。
归兴浓如酒。
